intent.text: I'll be walking 8+ hours a day with my backpack in Europe, need something comfortable with real back support, 30-35L, under 120 euro

reasons_for.text: AirScape mesh back panel and hipbelt designed for all-day carry
explicitly marketed for all-day carry comfort

reasons_against.text: EUR 165 exceeds the stated 120 euro budget
40L / 55cm may exceed strict low-cost cabin limits

reasons_for.text: 760g and EUR 79.95 fit the budget easily

reasons_against.text: no information available about back support or long-wear comfort

narrative: For 8+ hours of walking per day, carry comfort is the deciding factor. The Osprey Farpoint 40 provides a suspended AirScape mesh back panel, a load-bearing hipbelt and adjustable torso fit, which directly address all-day carry. The CabinZero Classic 36L is lighter and well within budget, but its listing provides no information about back support or harness structure, so I cannot assess its comfort for long walking days. If you can stretch the budget, the Farpoint 40 is the safer choice; note it exceeds your EUR 120 cap.
